reason: Replaces an unsupported special-versus-temporary permit distinction with the source-supported scope rule for a Temporary/Special Permit.

source_audit_support.source_locator: PRBoA Resolution No. 03 s.2008, Definition of Temporary/Special Permit and Section 11
source_audit_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: Temporary/Special Permit can only be issued to an individual foreign architect ... issued to a foreign architect for one (1) project alone.

proposed.text: Under PRBoA Resolution No. 03 s.2008, what is the scope of a Temporary/Special Permit issued to a foreign architect?

options.text: It is issued to an individual foreign architect and is limited to one project
It is issued to a foreign architectural firm and covers all Philippine projects for one year
It is a permanent Philippine license once the foreign architect has a Filipino counterpart
It allows independent signing and sealing as Architect-of-record

proposed.code_citation: PRBoA Resolution No. 03 s.2008, Temporary/Special Permit Guidelines, PDF pp.4 and 8.

rationale.a: Correct. The source states that a Temporary/Special Permit is issued to an individual foreign architect and Section 11 limits the permit to one project.
rationale.b: The source states the permit can only be issued to an individual foreign architect, not a foreign architectural firm.
rationale.c: A Temporary/Special Permit is limited in period and scope; it is not permanent registration.
rationale.d: Section 10 states that the Architect-of-record role is reserved to the Filipino counterpart.
rationale.correct: PRBoA Resolution No. 03 s.2008 treats the Temporary/Special Permit as an individual, project-limited authority for a foreign architect.
rationale.takeaway: Temporary/Special Permit = individual foreign architect + one project.
